status: Source increment only; P06 remains incomplete, uncommitted, uncompiled and unvalidated.
previous_goal_turn: Progress: the requested conflict check completed against fresh main/PR refs; no conflict action was required. The next unfinished source work resumed.
implemented: Animation capture setup/reset/root motion/ragdoll now reject missing physical support and invalid complete positions through CaptureAdmission. Authored-plane observations remain distinct. A closed admission run condition precedes the drive system Single terrain parameter. Root motion is extracted.
TerrainSummary retains checked elevation bounds through Serde, with metres projected only in final camera arithmetic.
Dispatcher geology and mapped fault surfaces retain checked scene points through finite differences and actual Proj4 projection. MappedLandformProfile names the kind/lithology payload.

InspectionSource owns diagnostic playable/vista support sampling. Thresholds, terrace callbacks, gate profiles, comparisons and perimeter quantities retain checked points/elevations. Source observations have a focused owner and typed missing-opening rejection.

Extrema use canonical GeographicHeightControl with strict comparisons. The optional displacement maximum uses SurfaceDifferenceControl: absence no longer claims zero at origin, and a real first zero keeps its actual point. Native clipping/interpolation/integration are preserved.

Viewer boundary captures retain all ten unchanged authored points and reject missing terrain/support by failure.txt plus AppExit::error. Optional debris remains optional. Required camera/catalog/understory support no longer defaults to zero or panics at the query.

Viewer obstacle admission completes the batch before physics/overlay commands and retains Position<Scene> to Transform. Projection/native visual setup and catalogue staging/framing are extracted from large roots.
Two existing production asserts become typed failures; no test assertions/cases/helpers are added or removed.

Oak sites retain checked footprint/elevation/root through ranking and focus. Neighbour absence uses the real observed centre as the existing slope estimator did. Species/variant/obstacle identity APIs take ScenePlanPoint, ending at actual community or bit-framing kernels.
Art-demo errors preserve structured JSON/SceneInput/collider/weapon/asset-load causes through exhibit/cache state using Arc. Only final DemoStatus text formats them.

Retained tree-variant restoration now belongs to residency; a named TerrainBarkBinding shares the admitted contact/terrain/material inputs for restored and newly generated bark. The presenter raw source excerpt shrinks from 148 to 142 lines; the official quality gate has not run.
